Basic: Every other fighter within 3 inches is **Flustered**

Choose two fighters in base contact with each other, in view within 8 inches: each is moved **2 inches straight away** from the other. Resolve the one closest to the user first (a move like this gives no parting blow)
Boosted (1 Energy): The user's player decides which of the two moves and in which direction, up to 2 inches each

Basic: One **Announced** fighter in view within 8 inches stops being Announced
Boosted (1 Energy): Every Announced fighter within 4 inches of them too, friend or foe

Basic: A fighter in view within 6 inches is **Shook** (dazzled)
Boosted (1 Energy): That fighter and every fighter within 2 inches of them

Basic: One enemy in view within 12 inches is **Announced**
A fighter within 3 inches is **Under warranty**
Boosted (1 Energy): And each ally within 2 inches of them too

Basic: A fighter within 3 inches has **Brace** on their next save: a passed save also stops Press and any knock
Boosted (1 Energy): The fighter and each ally within 2 inches of them

Basic: Take a **Hacked** token off one item or bot within 3 inches, with no test
**Powered**, range 12, Hits hard: a ranged Attack rolled with Tech
**Powered**, melee, Armour-piercing: a melee Attack rolled with Tech
**Powered**, range 6, Spread, Stun: a ranged Attack rolled with Tech
Each ally within 6 inches may step 2 inches free
Boosted (1 Energy): 4 inches, and each may also stand up free

Basic: One ally in view within 8 inches is **Hyped**
Boosted (1 Energy): And each ally within 2 inches of them

Basic: One ally in view within 8 inches stops being **Shook** and **Flustered**
Boosted (1 Energy): Every ally within 3 inches of the user

Basic: Clear one lasting condition from an ally in base contact
An ally in base contact regains **1 Energy**
One lasting condition on an ally in base contact has **no effect** until the end of the battle (it still counts toward going down)
Boosted (1 Energy): And the ally loses every **Shook**, **Flustered** and **Announced** token (their Hyped and Under warranty stay)
